import hashlib

# The salt appears to be "0000TBENCH-SALT" based on the image
# The "GALT = 6"0000TBENCH-SALT"" looks like "SALT = "0000TBENCH-SALT""

SALT = "0000TBENCH-SALT"

# Read the image bytes
with open('/app/code.png', 'rb') as f:
    img_bytes = f.read()

# First hash of the image bytes
h0 = hashlib.sha256(img_bytes).digest()

# Second hash: sha256(h0 || h0[0:10] || SALT)
# Based on the pseudocode: H = sha256(h0, h0[0:10], SALT)
# This likely means concatenating: h0 + h0[0:10] + SALT.encode()
data_to_hash = h0 + h0[:10] + SALT.encode()
H = hashlib.sha256(data_to_hash).hexdigest()

print(H)
EOF
